entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Kabir Neyriz is a Shi'ite Friday mosque, located in Neyriz, in the province of Fars, Iran. Construction of the mosque commenced during the Buyid era, most likely in 340 AH (951/952 CE), and was completed in 876 AH (1471/1472 CE), during the Safavid era. The mosque has a mix of architectural styles, and was predominately completed in the Seljuq style.
